operator_question: Can we safely and defensibly fly this mission?

status_legend.pass: Modeled margin is above the configured review threshold.
status_legend.warning: Modeled margin is positive, but close enough to require operator review.
status_legend.fail: Modeled margin is negative; modify the mission before release.
status_legend.unknown: ORBITAL does not have enough data to classify this group.

regulatory_metadata.ground_risk_population_note: Utility corridor inspection over mixed industrial and lightly populated roadside areas; operator should review site-specific ground risk before dispatch.
regulatory_metadata.approving_authority_source: Operator-provided example authority source for documentation-only demo
special_conditions_limitations: Remain within the modeled utility corridor and geofence buffers.
Do not launch if current field weather is below operator minimums.
regulatory_metadata.emergency_contingency_plan: Review lost-link, diversion, recovery, flyaway response, and incident-contact procedures before dispatch.
operating_assumptions: Pilot-in-command verifies current FAA, local, site, NOTAM, TFR, and airspace requirements before launch.
Mission remains within the modeled route, altitude, weather, battery, geofence, and crew constraints.
Visual observer staffing and crew communications are confirmed before dispatch.
unresolved_items: Confirm utility owner site-access approval for the planned inspection window.
Confirm launch and recovery area permissions with the local site contact.
regulatory_metadata.documentation_only_notice: For planning documentation only. ORBITAL does not provide LAANC, waivers, authorizations, legal approval, or operational clearance.
regulatory_metadata.decision_support_disclaimer: ORBITAL provides decision support only and is not legal approval. This report does not provide LAANC, waivers, authorizations, operational clearance, legal advice, or permission to fly. The pilot-in-command and operator remain responsible for all required regulatory review, approvals, and compliance decisions.

top_limiting_constraint.label: Wind / weather margin
top_limiting_constraint.status_meaning: Modeled margin is above the configured review threshold.
top_limiting_constraint.plain_english: Checks whether modeled or forecast wind stays below the configured safe operating limit.
top_limiting_constraint.why_this_matters_to_operator: Wind reduces endurance, increases tracking error, and can turn a feasible route into a recovery or containment problem.

margin.source: wind.max_safe_wind_mps minus the larger of simulation wind resources and weather.resolved wind speed or gust

top_limiting_constraint.recommendation: Wait for better wind or lower mission scope.
top_limiting_constraint.recommended_operator_action: Confirm launch-time weather against operator minimums and keep the forecast source with the mission package.

top_limiting_constraint_selection.risk_points_definition: Risk points increase when a constraint fails, is inside its warning band, or has little positive margin relative to its warning threshold.

selected_margin.source: wind.max_safe_wind_mps minus the larger of simulation wind resources and weather.resolved wind speed or gust

top_limiting_constraint_selection.explanation: Wind / weather margin was selected because it had the highest risk_points value (14.5) among 5 audited constraint groups. Its margin was 3.1 m/s against a warning threshold of 2.0 m/s.

top_three_risk_drivers.label: Battery reserve margin
top_three_risk_drivers.status_meaning: Modeled margin is above the configured review threshold.
top_three_risk_drivers.plain_english: Checks whether the planned sortie lands with the operator-required battery reserve still available.
top_three_risk_drivers.why_this_matters_to_operator: A BVLOS inspection needs enough remaining energy for delay, diversion, recovery, and conservative abort decisions.
top_three_risk_drivers.recommendation: Reduce route length or plan a relaunch / battery swap.
top_three_risk_drivers.recommended_operator_action: Keep the reserve assumption, confirm launch battery state, and brief abort reserve before dispatch.

top_three_risk_drivers.label: Route completion status
top_three_risk_drivers.status_meaning: Modeled margin is above the configured review threshold.
top_three_risk_drivers.plain_english: Checks whether the candidate plan reaches all required inspection points.
top_three_risk_drivers.why_this_matters_to_operator: Incomplete route coverage can waste a crew deployment and create pressure to improvise in the field.
top_three_risk_drivers.recommendation: Split the inspection into shorter sorties.
top_three_risk_drivers.recommended_operator_action: Confirm the waypoint list matches the inspection scope and brief any acceptable skipped-point policy.

constraint_groups.label: Turn / bank feasibility
constraint_groups.status_meaning: Modeled margin is above the configured review threshold.
constraint_groups.plain_english: Checks whether planned turns stay within configured bank-angle and turn-rate capability.
constraint_groups.why_this_matters_to_operator: Overly aggressive turns can break route tracking, increase energy use, and reduce safety margins near assets or geofences.
constraint_groups.recommendation: Lower cruise speed or add more turn spacing.
constraint_groups.recommended_operator_action: Keep the planned speed and turn assumptions, then verify they match the aircraft operating envelope.

assumptions_report.label: Battery / energy model
assumptions_report.source: scenario.initial_state, scenario.vehicle, simulation scalars, and battery constraints
assumptions_report.assumption: Battery feasibility is based on the configured capacity, initial charge, reserve policy, and simplified power model coefficients.
assumptions_report.operator_review_note: Confirm aircraft battery health, payload draw, temperature effects, and abort reserve outside ORBITAL before release.

assumptions_report.label: Wind / weather model
assumptions_report.source: scenario.wind, scenario.weather, weather.resolved, and simulation wind resources
assumptions_report.assumption: Wind feasibility compares the modeled or weather-provided wind exposure against the configured safe operating limit.
assumptions_report.operator_review_note: Refresh field weather and gust observations close to launch, especially when offline or sample weather is used.

assumptions_report.label: Geofence / no-fly-zone model
assumptions_report.source: scenario.geofence, imported GeoJSON zones, and simulation geofence scalars
assumptions_report.assumption: Geofence feasibility treats configured polygons and imported GeoJSON zones as the planning boundary source.
assumptions_report.operator_review_note: Confirm site boundaries, customer buffers, and launch/recovery areas on current maps before export or dispatch.

assumptions_report.label: Route completion model
assumptions_report.source: scenario.mission, route GeoJSON, plan waypoints, and simulation completion scalars
assumptions_report.assumption: The route is considered complete only when the simulation reaches the required inspection waypoints under the configured reach radius.
assumptions_report.operator_review_note: Confirm the waypoint list matches the inspection scope and define any acceptable skipped-point policy before dispatch.

assumptions_report.label: Turn / bank feasibility model
assumptions_report.source: scenario.vehicle, simulated yaw-rate resources, and bank-angle constraint margins
assumptions_report.assumption: Turn feasibility uses a simplified bank-angle/yaw-rate envelope rather than aircraft-specific autopilot tracking or detailed aerodynamics.
assumptions_report.operator_review_note: Confirm the route geometry, turn spacing, and selected speed are within the aircraft operating envelope.

assumptions_report.label: Robustness model
assumptions_report.assumption: Robustness reflects configured Monte Carlo perturbations only; it is not a certification, reliability guarantee, or live safety monitor.
assumptions_report.operator_review_note: Increase robustness cases or add scenario-specific uncertainty ranges when margin sensitivity matters.

model_limitations.limitation: Weather may come from offline, fallback, or sample inputs. ORBITAL records the source and timestamp, but the operator must verify current field weather before release.

Aircraft dynamics are simplified for feasibility planning. ORBITAL does not model every autopilot behavior, controller response, payload effect, battery aging factor, sensor constraint, or emergency maneuver.
Constraint margins are planning evidence for operator review. They do not approve a flight, issue authorization, or replace pilot-in-command judgment.
